source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7, code 06E and Worksheet for Code 06E, Lines 1 to 6; Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 30,000.00 + employer plan distribution (person 0) 12,000.00 = 42,000.00. Federal taxable income = 42,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 24,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Worksheet for Code 06E (first column): Line 1(a) 12,000.00 (person 0, age 66); Line 2(a) 0.00; Line 3(a) = 12,000.00; Line 4 12,000.00; Line 5(a) lesser of Lines 3 and 4 = 12,000.00. Line 6 = Line 5(a) = 12,000.00, code 06E. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 42,000.00. Line 3 total = 42,000.00. Exempt income: code 06E 12,000.00. Line 4H = 12,000.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 42,000.00 - 12,000.00 = 30,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 30,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 30,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 17,500.00. Line 11 = 17,500.00 x .03 = 525.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 525.00. Exactly 12,000.00 of employer plan income: Lines 3 and 4 are equal. The record lists employer plans because the worksheet takes everything on Form 1040 Lines 4b and 5b.
